_instructions.quick_start: Copy this file to Data/Config/LLM/claude.json (for global use) or Portfolios/<PortfolioName>/LLM/claude.json (portfolio-specific) and paste your Anthropic API key into 'api_key'.

key_types.anthropic_paid_api_key: RECOMMENDED. Create an API key at https://console.anthropic.com/settings/keys. Anthropic API keys start with 'sk-ant-api03-'. Note: Anthropic does NOT offer a free-tier API. You must fund your account with prepaid credits at https://console.anthropic.com/settings/billing before keys will work. A key with a $0 credit balance will produce an error in AdvisorBot.
key_types.rate_limits: Anthropic enforces Tier 1 through Tier 4 rate limits based on deposit history. For heavy simulation and prompt workflows, ensure your tier accommodates 50+ requests per minute.

_instructions.environment_variable_alternative: Instead of pasting your key here, you can set export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY='sk-ant-api03-...' in your shell (~/.bashrc or ~/.zshrc). If 'api_key' in this file is empty or starts with 'PASTE_YOUR_', AdvisorBot will automatically read ANTHROPIC_API_KEY from your environment.
_instructions.privacy_shield: When Privacy Shield is active, AdvisorBot strips sensitive financial identifiers (household names, account numbers, specific entity titles) and substitutes synthetic aliases (e.g. HOUSEHOLD_1, INVESTOR_1) before sending prompts to Anthropic endpoints.
